recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片以顆粒球系為主，混有多顆單核球（核呈摺疊或腎形、胞質灰藍並有細小空泡），部分帶狀核與分葉核嗜中性球的顆粒偏少，芽細胞並不多，符合慢性骨髓單核球性白血病（CMML-1）。
features: Myeloid-predominant cellular smear with abundant metamyelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils
Increased monocytes with folded, kidney-shaped or lobulated nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles
Subtle dysgranulopoiesis: some neutrophils and bands have reduced granulation
Scattered promyelocytes/myelocytes with azurophilic granules; blasts are not increased in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and myeloid predominant, with full granulocytic maturation including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Monocytes are increased, with folded to kidney-shaped nuclei, delicate chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm. Some neutrophils show subtle hypogranulation, and scattered late normoblasts are present. Blasts and promonocytes are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML-1, <5% marrow blasts) when correlated with persistent peripheral monocytosis.

ddx.vs: aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with <10% monocytes in the blood, whereas CMML shows a distinct monocytic component.
AMML requires ≥20% blasts including promonocytes, which have delicately folded nuclei with nucleoli and are not increased here.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and clonal mutations and shows a normal monocyte subset distribution by flow (classical monocytes <94%).
CML shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes and carries BCR::ABL1.
